description: FastAPI application defining endpoints for file uploads and a simple HTML form for testing file uploads.

methods.name: create_files( files: list[bytes] = File(description="Multiple files as bytes"), )
methods.description: Handles POST requests to /files/ for uploading multiple files as bytes, returning their sizes.

methods.name: create_upload_files( files: list[UploadFile] = File(description="Multiple files as UploadFile"), )
methods.description: Handles POST requests to /uploadfiles/ for uploading multiple files as UploadFile objects, returning filenames.

methods.name: main()
methods.description: Handles GET requests to /, serving an HTML form with file upload options.

ctags.name: create_files
ctags.signature: ( files: list[bytes] = File(description="Multiple files as bytes"), )

ctags.name: create_upload_files
ctags.signature: ( files: list[UploadFile] = File(description="Multiple files as UploadFile"), )
